name: Approvals banner
author: Brett
description: The veto banner: a banner at the top of the app whenever axHub holds a call on its countdown (veto@1: it runs by itself after 90 s unless you stop it) or has one waiting for approval. Held calls show a live countdown with Deny, Approve (run it now) and Shelve (pause the countdown until you decide); tapping one opens the veto screen. Its notices (timer started, 30 s left, running) and a configurable alarm (tone or your own sound, volume, louder over time, how long, repeats, vibration, when it starts, through silent mode on the phone) work in every app it is installed in: the console and AmberX. Only for admins signed in to axHub; it acts only on your tap. In the console, Approve and Deny stay in the console: the tap goes through its relay with your own hub session and the result shows where you tapped. The Approvals page (s6, console_open("approvals", focus="<id>")): every waiting and held call with Review and comments; GET pending (with versions), approval, comments, POST comment, GET|PUT settings (MCP approvals-banner_*; deciding stays a signed-in browser's tap).

items.skip: a person's tap only: it needs the signed-in browser's hub session, no session may ever call it

One waiting call with its comments
